answer.text:
According to Levi Strauss & Co.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 1, 2024:

* **Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses:** **$3,246.2 million**
* **Percentage of net revenues:** **51.1%**

### Calculations:
* $\text{Net Revenues} = \$6,355.3\text{ million}$
* $\text{SG&A Expenses} = \$3,246.2\text{ million}$
* $\text{Percentage of Net Revenues} = \frac{\$3,246.2\text{ million}}{\$6,355.3\text{ million}} \times 100\% \approx 51.0786\% \rightarrow \mathbf{51.1\%}$

*(Sources: Accession 0000094845-25-000005, Filing Summary, Chunk ID: `da80ad4b-2f94-5f0c-a589-c296c250a006` and Chunk ID: `7800a9af-162a-5e50-b146-b4ba64b4b763`)*
